facts.fact: The text of loi n°001-2021/AN, adopted by the Assemblée nationale on 30 March 2021, abrogates loi n°010-2004/AN and (art. 81) gives one year from entry into force for all processing to comply.

facts.fact: Articles 45 to 55 create the CIL as the supervisory authority, with nine members appointed by decree in the Council of Ministers; art. 80 keeps members already appointed in place.
